mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. Skies are clear over the Military Ridge State Trail, but we are seeing an elevated air quality index of 55 today. If you are out late tonight, the moon is in a waxing gibbous phase and the International Space Station will be visible at 10:25 PM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling low toward the horizon in the direction of Belleville.

In city news, the Verona I Voted sticker contest for students in grades K through 12 has officially closed. The city is preparing to let the community vote on the winning designs starting July 28 through August 7, with the chosen art appearing on stickers for the November election. Also, residents are reminded to check their mailboxes to ensure they meet U.S. Postal Service specifications before the winter plowing season begins.

We have a great lineup of local activities. Live music is taking place today at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square or enjoy the music series at Paddy Mac's.

Looking at the police department's weekly report, an incident occurred on July 13 where a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O-W-I after officers responded to a vehicle that had become stuck on a large rock.
For dessert today, Culver's is serving up their Chocolate Volcano flavor. It is a fantastic choice, and you have plenty of time to enjoy it since they are open until 10:30 PM tonight.
